name: le-gume
description: A self-documenting documentation site. Replaces the hard parts of shipping docs with a build that already knows them.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/deck.mjs && vite build --ssr scripts/prerender.tsx --outDir .prerender --emptyOutDir && node .prerender/prerender.js && node scripts/postbuild.mjs && node scripts/doomlint.mjs dist --fail-on high && node scripts/a11y.mjs dist --fail-on high && node scripts/verify-publish.mjs
